Each `pairs` value is {"lines": N, "reason": "…"}: the reason is mandatory and says why this duplication stays, or starts with `TODO: ` when it should be extracted and the reason says how. `pnpm check jscpd-rust` shrink-wraps the numbers, so a reason is the only part written by hand. See `.claude/rules/file-length-allowlist.md`.

`rotate_local_cycle` and `rotate_remote_cycle`: the cycle-breaking rotation (move the first row aside to a unique temp, rename the rest in reverse order, land the temp on the first destination, and restore the half-rotation on any failure). One is written against the sync `rename_local_exclusive`, the other against `Volume::rename(...).await`, and the differences carry the safety contract: local gets a kernel-atomic no-overwrite rename and a sync `SourceFingerprint::capture_local`, remote can only ask its backend not to overwrite and awaits a fingerprint per row. Folding them takes an async abstraction over one rename, which puts a boxed future in the local hot loop and hides the asymmetry a reader of a data-destroying path most needs to see.

apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/volumes/mod.r.reason: The `list_locations` preamble in the macOS and Linux twins: two `HashSet` accumulators and the `push_unique` closure that inserts into both sets before pushing. The rule that could drift, dedupe on path AND id rather than path alone, is already stated as an invariant in both `CLAUDE.md`s.
